_comment: Catalog of Facetwork DOMAINS (pluggable fwh_* production pipelines) and in-repo EXAMPLES (teaching demos). Single source of truth for fw install/migrate/fleet + compose generation. Override per deployment WITHOUT editing any command: set FW_DOMAINS_FILE=/path (full replace), or drop a gitignored domains.local.json (merged over this file: entries add/replace by key; a top-level "_remove": ["name", ...] drops standard ones). The per-domain "compose" object drives `fw util gen-compose`, which regenerates the runner-<service> blocks in docker-compose.full-stack.yml between the GENERATED markers. See docs/reference/domain-catalog.md.
_index_dir_comment: Host directory holding the maintained OSM tag indexes, mounted READ-ONLY into runner-generalist as /opt/fw_osm_indexes. Shared (not host-local) so `fw util gen-compose` produces the SAME file on every host — a per-host value here silently desyncs the committed artefact. A host whose tree lives elsewhere overrides the PATH with FW_OSM_INDEX_HOST_DIR, no regeneration needed. A host with no tree at all mounts an empty dir, which the consumers handle: index_file() returns None when the .sqlite is absent and they fall back to Overpass.

anthropic.description: Anthropic API wrappers (Messages, Batch, Files, Agent SDK, Claude Code, Computer Use)

notes: Durable cache + output → MinIO (osm-s3-env); staging/tmp/locks → /scratch (the LARGE external disk, NOT the small internal volume — continent extracts staged on the internal disk ENOSPC-crash the shared mongodb volume).

Timeouts raised to 4h: multi-GB Geofabrik downloads + osmium parses run for hours; the 15min/30min/5min defaults would kill long facets or let another runner steal a 30GB download mid-flight. Matches fwh_osm's DomainPackage runner_env.

osm-lz.description: Continental-scale OSM workflow catalog (depends on fwh_osm)

notes: Pure workflow catalog over fwh_osm — its facets dispatch to the osm-geocoder runner's handlers, so start that one first (depends_on) and mount fwh_osm read-only.
Same 4h timeouts + external scratch as osm-geocoder: it orchestrates continental fan-outs that stage multi-GB PBFs and run for hours.

conflict.description: UCDP armed-conflict world maps (events, deaths, civilian targeting, intensity, armed actors)

migration.description: World Bank net-migration world map with a year slider (1960-2025): green=net immigration, red=net emigration per 1,000 pop

stocks.description: Stock-group paper-trading tracker: factor + analyst + optional LLM selection, daily mark-to-market snapshots, per-position and overall P/L vs a benchmark

amr.description: Antibiotic-resistance gene spread (country x year x species) from NCBI Pathogen Detection: world resistance-prevalence map (year slider + drug-class dropdown) + gene x species table

osm-mapping.description: OSM mapping-equity world map: mapped health facilities per capita (under-mapping vs population)

h1b.description: US H-1B visa approvals by state & county, multi-year (USCIS H-1B Employer Data Hub)

congress.description: US congressional (voting) districts colored by sitting-rep party (Census CD119 + congress-legislators)

livability.description: Equal-weight US county livability composite (ACS + CDC PLACES + FEMA NRI + EPA AQI) -> choropleth + top-50 rankings

health.description: Disease-burden choropleths (cancer/diabetes/Alzheimer's/stroke) — CDC NCHS + PLACES + WHO, US state/county + world

save-earth.description: Open environmental datasets (OpenLitterMap, EPA Superfund/Brownfields/TRI, OSM nuclear) → MapLibre HTML maps

sentinel2-landchange.description: Sentinel-2 land-cover change (STAC + COG → NDVI/composite → difference/classify → MapLibre tiled map)

pypsa-data.description: PyPSA-Eur dataset catalogue (data/versions.csv) → retrieved + unpacked via the built-in fw.http/fw.archive facets; the FFL port of rules/retrieve.smk

pypsa-earth.description: PyPSA-Earth's OSM stage (build_shapes -> download/clean/build_osm_network) as FFL; raw OpenStreetMap power infrastructure -> grid topology. Calls upstream's own functions, so the payload is theirs. NOT fleet-deployed: needs a pypsa-earth checkout (FW_PYPSA_EARTH_DIR) plus ~178 MiB of its dependencies on the host

gridbuilder.description: OpenStreetMap power infrastructure (substations, lines) → model-ready grid CSV/GeoJSON per country; the FFL equivalent of PyPSA grid-builder

notes: Each retrieval downloads a regional PBF (Belgium ~660MB), so the
earth-osm cache lives on the mounted data volume rather than the
container layer: a container-local cache re-downloads on every
restart and grows the Docker VM disk, which is how a previous
concurrent fan-out took Mongo down with it.

cancer.description: Cancer gene-prioritization evidence graph (TCGA/GDC + GTEx + intOGen) -> ranked evidence table

peloton.description: Group cycling photos -> per-rider enhanced portraits (detect -> crop -> enhance; 16-bit TIFF; nef-to-tif)

groupphoto.description: Enhance posed group photos (deblur + glare/highlight correction + optional background replacement)

county-atlas.description: Per-county information maps (OSM + census/CDC/EPA/USGS/NOAA/FEMA/HUD) + US→state→county index

hiv-drug-resistance.description: foreach fan-out over sequences; classic teaching workflow
